draft.quote: Drones hit the port zone of Ust-Luga overnight on 11 November, starting a fire and injuring three workers
draft.summary: Leningrad Oblast Governor Aleksandr Drozdenko said drones hit the Ust-Luga port zone overnight on 11 November, starting a fire and injuring three workers. He also reported that a transformer substation had shut down. The Ukrinform article could not be retrieved directly, so this report from Euromaidan Press is used instead.
